title: Devanagari pairing and Hindi text rules
summary: Adds system Devanagari faces (Kohinoor Devanagari on Apple, Noto Sans Devanagari on Android) after Inter in the sans stack, and `:lang(hi)` rules: body line-height ≥ 1.6, no letter-spacing, no forced uppercase on eyebrows and group labels.
migration: No new font downloads (system fonts only). Mark Hindi content with lang="hi" to get the rules. tokens.json `families.sans` changes. Full Hindi consent text still needs a qualified translator.

compare.title: Hindi copy in the product components
compare.note: Same markup on both sides (lang="hi"). The preview gives both sides the same Devanagari glyphs (Noto Sans Devanagari, preview only), so the comparison isolates the new rules: taller lines, no spaced capitals on the eyebrow and group label, no negative tracking.
